quality_boundary: This inventory confirms official entry points, current and prior plan periods, the embedded implementation structure, and fiscal document landings only. It does not promote indicators, progress claims, budget items, settlement values, project execution, or outcome claims to Reviewed, linked, comparable, or policy-achievement status.
next_action: Resolve the canonical page ranges for the 2026–2029 plan, map its 14 policy groups and 33 measure groups, preserve the prior-plan progress bridge, and review fiscal 2026 budget and fiscal 2024 settlement records at page-level evidence depth.
